name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx as a multi-site web server for three virtual sites, including document roots, SSL configuration, security controls, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and development TLS certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and runtime settings, creates the Redis log directory, and removes selected replication directives from the generated configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI application with Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, a Git checkout, virtual environment, database and user, generated environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service on port 8000.
